confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or 2026 price data. Egypt's currency has been volatile and many tourist venues use dual pricing, so the ranges are wide. Restaurant and café anchors are somewhat more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors. The hostel and hotel figures are the least certain. Beer, cocktail and wine are estimated from the local restaurant and bar price relationship because direct knowledge of current prices is limited.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is general knowledge of Cairo's mid-market and tourist-facing price levels, relative to other large North African and Middle Eastern tourism cities. Egypt is classified as Africa for this record. Beer, cocktail and wine anchors are set relative to the local restaurant price of a domestic beer.
